simple.meaning: אַיָּל (ʼayâl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a stag or male deer.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 12:15. The surrounding context includes family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַיָּל (H354) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אַיָּל (ʼayâl) / H354 is traced through Deuteronomy 12:15, Deuteronomy 12:22, Deuteronomy 14:5, Deuteronomy 15:22 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

timeline.evidenceText: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.
Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.
the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.
You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

“You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until Yahweh put his enemies under the soles of his feet.
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.
Then the lame man will leap like a deer,
All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion.

definitions.full: H354. ayyal אַיָּל noun [masculine] ( feminine Psa 42:2 ) hart, stag, deer (Aramaic id. , , Arabic , Assyrian ailu Dl w , but dubious, see Hpt BAS i. 170 ; Ethiopic = leader ? compare אַיִל ) Arabic = ibex (i. q. , ). — ׳א absolute Deut 12:15 6 t.; plural אַיָּלִים Song 2:9 3 t.; — hart, stag , allowed as food Deut 12:15 , 22 ; 15:22 (all || צְבִי ); 14:5 ; (|| יַחְמוּר צְבִי, etc.); eaten in Solomon's household 1Kin 5:3 (|| as Deut 14:5 ); simile of leaping Isa 35:6 ; id. הָא ׳עֹפֶר Song 2:9 , 17 ; 8:14 (all || צְבִי ); as in search of pasture, simile of princes of Judah Lam 1:6 ; as longing for water, simile of longing for ׳י Psa 42:2 .
definitions.rootNote: an intensive form of 352 (in the sense of ram);
